newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE shares mostly steady in active week's trade.
newsitem.headline: UAE shares mostly steady in active week's trade.

text.p: Shares on the United Arab Emirates (UAE) unofficial stock market ended the week to Thursday mostly steady in active trade, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index crept up 4.3 points to 2,533.36 points from 2,529.06 points a week earlier.
Ten shares rose, five declined and the rest remained steady, brokers said.
Among major gainers were market leader Etisalat which rose 10 dirhams to 965 and NBAD which ended the week five dirhams higher at 515.
After climbing 15 dirhams the previous week, al-Khazna Insurance stuck within a tight range this week, closing stable at 300 dirhams.
